list.title: Members
list.subtitle: Wellness+ members, their tier and status.
list.searchPlaceholder: Name, member ID, phone or email
list.empty: No members yet. Register the first one.
list.loadFailed: The members could not be loaded.

form.intro: First and last name are required, and at least one of date of birth, phone or email, so the person can be recognised later.
form.noteWarning: Do not write any medical information here: no diagnosis, no result, no service used.

errors.dateOfBirth: Enter a real date of birth that is not in the future.
errors.identifier: Enter a date of birth, a phone number or an email.
errors.cityId: Choose one of the predefined cities.
errors.generic: The member could not be saved.

duplicate.title: This person may already be a member
duplicate.body: A member with the same email, phone, or name and date of birth exists. Open the existing member, or save this one as a different person.

detail.loadFailed: The member could not be loaded.

tierCard.title: Current tier
tierCard.floor: Bronze is the free level every active member has.

terms.title: Term history
terms.empty: No paid, sponsored or VIP term yet. The member is Bronze.

history.tierEmpty: The tier has not changed yet.

correctTier.title: Correct the tier
correctTier.help: Gives the member a corrected term from today to the end date. It is recorded in the tier history as a correction and in the audit log.
correctTier.endsOnInvalid: Choose an end date that is today or later.
correctTier.failed: The tier could not be corrected. Check the details and try again.

statusDialog.suspendHelp: A suspended member is not valid: the card shows no discounts. The tier does not change.
statusDialog.closeHelp: Closing keeps the record and the member ID. A closed member can be reopened.
statusDialog.reasonRequired: A reason is required to suspend a member.
statusDialog.failed: The status could not be changed.

warning.SPONSORED_SILVER_OWN_TERM: This employee already has Silver paid by the company. This payment starts a separate Silver term that stays with the person after leaving the company.

drawer.title: Record a payment
drawer.dateRefused: The date received cannot be in the future.
drawer.noOptions: No payment can be recorded for this member on this date.
drawer.loadFailed: The payment options could not be loaded.
drawer.calculated: The amount is calculated by the platform and cannot be changed.
drawer.failed: The payment could not be saved. Try again.

refused.MEMBER_NOT_ACTIVE: Only an active member can pay.
refused.NOT_A_HIGHER_TIER: A payment cannot move a member to a lower tier.
refused.PAID_TERM_RUNNING: This member already has a paid term. Renew or upgrade it instead.
refused.NOTHING_TO_RENEW: There is no paid term of this tier to renew.
refused.NOTHING_TO_UPGRADE: There is no paid tier to upgrade. Buy the tier as a new membership.
refused.USE_UPGRADE: This member already holds a tier. Pay the difference as an upgrade.

tab.title: Payments
tab.empty: No payment has been recorded for this member.

voidDialog.title: Void this payment
voidDialog.help: Voiding takes back the effect of the payment: the earlier tier and term are restored. The receipt number stays and is marked Voided.
voidDialog.reasonRequired: A reason is required to void a payment.
voidDialog.notLatest: Only the latest payment of a member can be voided. Void the later payment first.
voidDialog.failed: The payment could not be voided. Try again.

page.title: Membership payments
page.subtitle: Every Wellness+ payment, with the receipt for each.
page.loadFailed: The payments could not be loaded.
page.empty: No membership payment has been recorded yet.

family.title: Family
family.empty: This member has no family members yet.

addDialog.title: Add a family member
addDialog.search: Search by name, ID, phone or email
addDialog.confirmed: I confirm that the relationship was checked.
addDialog.failed: The family member could not be saved.

removeDialog.title: Remove the family link
removeDialog.help: The member keeps the membership and all terms. Later payments are at the full price. The change is recorded.
removeDialog.failed: The link could not be removed.

refused.SELF_LINK: A member cannot be linked to themselves.
refused.PRINCIPAL_IS_FAMILY_MEMBER: This member is a family member of someone else, so cannot be a principal.
refused.ALREADY_HAS_PRINCIPAL: This member already has a principal.
refused.MEMBER_IS_PRINCIPAL: This member already has family members, so cannot become a family member.
refused.NOT_A_FAMILY_MEMBER: This member has no family link.

vip.title: VIP
vip.empty: No VIP requests for this member.
vip.failed: The action could not be completed.
vip.ownRequest: You made this request; another approver decides it.

requestDialog.title: Request VIP
requestDialog.help: Say why this member should be VIP, for example strategic client, PR relationship or key partner. Another user with the approval permission decides.

endDialog.title: End VIP
endDialog.help: The member returns today to the highest other valid tier, Bronze if none. The reason is kept in the history.

decide.approveHelp: Approving gives a free VIP term from today for the VIP length, with a review date equal to its end. If the member is already VIP, it continues from the next day.
decide.reasonRequired: A reason is required to reject.
decide.failed: The decision could not be saved.

list.title: VIP requests
list.subtitle: Requests waiting for a decision, and past decisions.
list.loadFailed: The VIP requests could not be loaded.

refused.MEMBER_CLOSED: A closed member cannot be given VIP.
refused.OPEN_REQUEST: This member already has an open VIP request.
refused.OWN_REQUEST: You cannot decide a request you made yourself.
refused.NOT_PENDING: This request has already been decided.

employees.title: Employee upload
employees.subtitle: Add a company's employees as sponsored Silver members from an Excel file. Nothing is created until you confirm.
employees.fileHelp: An Excel .xlsx file with at most 1,000 rows and 2 MB. The company needs a valid contract today.

refusal.NO_VALID_CONTRACT: No valid contract: the company needs a valid contract today before its employees can be uploaded.
refusal.NOT_XLSX: The file is not an Excel .xlsx workbook.
refusal.HAS_MACROS: Workbooks with macros (.xlsm) are not accepted. Save the file as .xlsx.
refusal.TOO_LARGE: The file must be smaller than 2 MB.
refusal.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has more than 1,000 rows, which is the limit.
refusal.MISSING_COLUMNS: The first row must have the columns First name and Last name.
refusal.EMPTY_FILE: The file has no employee rows.
refusal.EXPIRED: The preview expired after 24 hours. Upload the file again.
refusal.BAD_TOKEN: This confirmation does not match the preview. Upload the file again.

removeEmployer.title: Remove from company
removeEmployer.help: {{company}} will no longer sponsor this member's Silver. Any tier they paid for stays, and they are kept as a former employee.
removeEmployer.helpMany: {{count}} selected members will be removed together. Any tier they paid for stays, and they are kept as former employees.
removeEmployer.leftOnInvalid: Choose a day that is not in the future.
removeEmployer.notEmployee: This member is not linked to a company any more.
removeEmployer.failed: The removal could not be saved. Try again.

companyTab.sponsorNone: The company has no valid contract, so sponsored Silver is not active.
companyTab.noMembers: No employees are linked to this company yet.
companyTab.noUploads: No employee list was uploaded for this company.
companyTab.cardLinksFailed: The card links could not be downloaded.

card.title: Member card
card.help: The member opens this link on their phone. They do not sign in.
card.replaced: A new link is ready. The old one no longer works.
card.replaceFailed: The link could not be replaced. Try again.
card.loadFailed: The card could not be loaded.
card.qrAlt: QR code of the card of {{name}}
card.notValid: This membership is not valid, so the member's card shows no QR code and no discounts.

replaceDialog.title: Replace the card link?
replaceDialog.help: The old link and every copy of it on a phone stop working at once and show that the card was replaced. Give the member the new link.
